about: Whether each Turkish leaderboard model's official card or maker docs list Turkish (Ümit #5067 item 3, confirmed by Zeki #5085): listed (the line naming Turkish), not listed (the languages it lists) or not stated (no language named); a model whose card does not list Turkish is marked 'Turkish not officially supported' on the Turkish leaderboards (sitebuild/leaderboard.py). keys: the setups' provider and model; read: the day each source was read (subagent TurkishSupport, 12 November 2026). rule: Mark 'Turkish not officially supported' on every model whose status is not 'listed' (Ümit #5067 item 3).
